Photorealistic live-action Japanese human drama, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, no flat lighting. Over Hikaru's blurred shoulder (right foreground), low angle: Washio half-rising, one fist on the desk, face red with fury behind the gold glasses, brow knotted, lips closed between words. Characters: Washio, a heavy-set Japanese man aged 59, thick jaw and jowls, greying black hair slicked straight back, thin round GOLD-rimmed glasses, bushy eyebrows, clean-shaven, wearing a dark navy double-breasted suit with no pin, a plain white shirt, a plain crimson necktie, a plain gold wristwatch on the LEFT wrist | Takeuchi Hikaru, a slim Japanese man aged 26, fair skin, gentle oval face, calm dark eyes, short black hair with slightly long bangs, a small dark mole just below his LEFT eye, no glasses, no earrings, clean-shaven, wearing a plain light-grey cotton work jacket with no logo over a plain white t-shirt, a plain white towel around the neck, dark-grey work trousers. Camera: low-angle looking up, 50mm lens, f/2.0, over-the-shoulder three-quarter framing, the listener's blurred shoulder and back of the head in the near foreground edge, the speaker's face at least one third of the frame height. Lighting: cold 5600K daylight through vertical blinds, strong stripes of light, chiaroscuro. Over-the-shoulder two-shot: the listener's blurred shoulder and back of the head at the near foreground edge, the speaker beyond facing the listener at 30 to 40 degrees from the camera axis, the speaker's face at least one third of the frame height, the speaker's mouth closed, hands visible doing the described work. Exactly two people, no extra people. All papers, screens, signs, cards and labels are completely blank; no letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the frame. Negative: gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, posters with writing, documents with writing, screens with text, printed labels, brand logos, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, blood, gore, handcuffs, police, earrings. The executive office walls are bare; book spines are plain; no plaques, no framed certificates with writing. CAMERA: low angle, looking up from about waist height. Over-the-shoulder two-shot composition: the listener is at the near foreground edge seen strictly from behind — only the back of the head, hair and one shoulder, soft and out of focus; the listener's face is NOT visible. MEDIUM CLOSE-UP, the camera about 1.5 metres from the speaker: the speaker's head is near the top edge of the frame and the frame is cut at mid-chest, so the speaker's head and shoulders fill the centre of the frame and the face is about one third of the frame height (NOT a wide shot, NOT full body, the room is only a blurred background). Framing from mid-chest up: the speaker's head and shoulders fill the frame, the face about one third of the frame height and sharp, turned about 35 degrees toward the other person (never straight at the camera, never full profile); the speaker's hands and what they hold are visible at the bottom of the frame; 50mm lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field. Fury shown only in the wide-open glaring eyes, furrowed brow, flared nostrils and clenched jaw: eyes OPEN and fixed on the listener, lips pressed together, mouth CLOSED, NOT shouting (speech is added later). Mouth gently closed or barely parted (speech is added later); natural skin texture, both eyes sharp and symmetrical; no earrings. Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere in the image.
